xiaohongshu-post-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Xiaohongshu Post Generator.
- Generates editable Xiaohongshu-ready posts and slides with AI-generated content, captions, images, text blocks, and backgrounds.
- Supports multiple formats, including Knowledge Cards, Posters, and Movie Introductions.
- Automatically structures designs according to visual style rules, ensuring export-ready results.
- Powered by Nano Banana, Nano Banana 2, and Imagen 2.
